Christina Applegate reveals misdiagnosis of Multiple Sclerosis

Actress Christina Applegate has stated that she was misdiagnosed with Multiple Sclerosis (MS). The news of the misdiagnosis was described as devastating. The coverage does not specify the timeline of the misdiagnosis or the subsequent correct diagnosis, nor does it detail the reasons behind the initial misdiagnosis or the impact of the news.
